name: Maddy
bio: Maddy started in the dog boarding/daycare industry in 2019. She is finishing her Bachelor’s degree in Psychology and working toward her Master’s Degree in Counselling. Maddy owns two dogs: Kane (Rotti cross), Berklee (Golden Retriever) and a Siamese cat named Baker. She is passionate about rescue and giving animals second chances. In her spare time she likes to go on road trips, watch movies and paint.
